description: Displayed on the lawns of the heritage museum opened Sept 2001 by ACM Tipnis inside AFS Jodhpur (warbirds.in).
Desert-camouflaged Su-7 on the museum lawns; serial B-790 per warbirds.in table.
Unidentified HT-2 in front of the main building (warbirds.in).
MiG-27 reported on the lawns (Sainik Samachar via warbirds.in 2005); serial not recorded.
MiG-27ML with Cope India 2006 shark-teeth paint, park-mounted in the open at Jodhpur (Bharat Rakshak); WBI mentions a MiG-27 on the museum lawns.
aliases: MiG27ML; TS556; shark teeth; MiG27; TS-556
